Technician visit panni exact fault check pannumbodhu control board-la moisture power surge aala motor driver triac track burnt aayirundhuchu. Part cost and labour estimate customer-ku munbave solli, control board motor triac spot-la change pannanga. Multi-point testing mudinju machine fault-free-ah deliver aachu, repair cost ₹1,500 – ₹2,800.
